title: Will SpaceX launch another Starship before Oct 1, 2026?
rules_primary: If SpaceX launches Starship flight test number 14 After issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: For the purpose of this market, the launch date is the calendar date on which liftoff occurred, measured in the local timezone of the launch site, as publicly confirmed by SpaceX
normalization_notes: Launch means liftoff with sustained ascent; scrubs and static fires do not count, while a failure after liftoff still counts. Only flight test 14 after market issuance counts. The calendar boundary is launch-site local time; the numeric deadline uses America/Chicago for Starbase and must be flagged if the launch site differs.
instruction: Only rules are supplied; no prices, order books, volume or prior forecasts. Do not browse exchange pages for price discovery.
